'''Friedhelm Eicker''' (5 April 1927 – 19 March 2022) was a German [[statistician]] and [[Emeritus|former professor]] at the [[University of Dortmund]]. He is known for his contributions in the development of [[heteroscedasticity-consistent standard errors]].<ref>{{Cite book |last=Eicker |first=Friedhelm |chapter=Limit Theorems for Regression with Unequal and Dependent Errors |title=Proceedings of the Fifth Berkeley Symposium on Mathematical Statistics and Probability |year=1967 |volume=5 |issue=1 |pages=59–82 |publisher=University of California Press |url=http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.bsmsp/1200512981 |mr=0214223 |zbl=0217.51201 }}</ref>

A native of [[Radevormwald]], Eicker earned his PhD from the [[University of Mainz]] in 1956.<ref>{{MathGenealogy |id=21546 }}</ref>
